Subject: SIG bundle + portal upload for Acme procurement

Hi Lauren / Rishi,

We're moving toward final procurement review and need a full SIG bundle + upload to our vendor portals (OneTrust and Whistic). Procurement will validate:
- Completed SIG questionnaire (PDF export)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok)
- Evidence index / manifest (CSV) with attachment filenames, generation timestamps, and checksums
- An audit trace showing who uploaded which file and when (portal IDs preferred)

Can you please provide: consolidated PDF (bookmarked, with answers + evidence links), the CSV manifest, and the staging S3 link for our security team to spot-check before we run portal imports? Our deadline is EOD Wednesday (June 30).

Thanks — please loop in whoever owns PDF generation and uploads.

Amy Reynolds
Procurement Lead, Acme Health
amy.reynolds@acmehealth.com
procurement@acmehealth.com

Hi Amy — thanks for the heads up. We're on it. High-level plan and attachments below.

What we will deliver (by EOD Wed):
1) Consolidated SIG PDF (SIG_Answers_20260628.pdf) — answers followed by embedded evidence pages. PDF bookmarks at question sections.
2) SOC 2 Type II (SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2025.pdf) — redacted PII per your policy.
3) Evidence index/manifest (SIG_Manifest_20260630.csv) — columns: filename, description, evidence_type, generated_at (UTC), sha256_checksum, redwood_staging_path
4) Zipped package (SIG_Package_v1.zip) for manual download (contains original artifacts + manifest)
5) Staging S3: s3://redwood-staging/sig/acmehealth/2026-06-30/ — public share link below (expires in 7 days).

Upload notes / constraints we observed with portals:
- OneTrust prefers flattened PDFs and sometimes rejects incremental xref tables; we'll flatten and run PDF/A-1b export.
- Whistic has a 10 MB per-file limit for certain evidence types; we will split large evidence into multiple files and reference them in the manifest.
- We will include SHA256 checksums for each file and include a manifest row for the consolidated PDF and each individual evidence artifact.

Action items (owners):
- Monica Patel: generate consolidated PDF (PDF/A), run final QA on bookmarks, compute checksums, produce CSV manifest.
- Rishi Malhotra: perform portal uploads (OneTrust/Whistic), capture upload IDs/screenshots, paste portal upload URLs into the manifest, and share portal audit IDs.
- Lauren Bishop (me): coordinate attestation/DocuSign and confirm with Acme procurement.

Attached: draft SIG_Answers_20260628.pdf (answers only) and SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2025.pdf (redacted).

I'll post the S3 staging link once Monica uploads the package.

Best,

Lauren Bishop

Lauren / Monica / Amy — quick notes from portal tests this morning:
- Whistic: their import will accept a single consolidated PDF but strips bookmarks during preview. Recommend we also upload a small "index.pdf" (first page with clickable links) to preserve navigation for reviewers.
- OneTrust: we had a rejection on a previous run due to metadata mismatch (XMP fields). We should clear custom XMP and set Title = "Redwood Inference - SIG Package - Acme Health" before upload.
- Checksums: use lower-case hex sha256; include algorithm label in CSV header (e.g., sha256:sha256sum).

Monica — can you flatten PDF/A, export a separate index.pdf (1 page), and add checksums to the manifest? Put everything in the S3 staging path Lauren noted. If you run into size issues, split attachments into evidence_1.pdf / evidence_2.pdf and reference them individually.

Also, procurement sometimes requires a signed attestation (DocuSign). Lauren, please share the DocuSign powerform link and we'll attach the envelope ID to the manifest.

- Rishi
